params.caption: Nepali Folk-Rock fusion in 3/4 time signature. Driven by a powerful, earthy Madal rhythm (Khyali pattern) and a heavy, melodic bassline. Blend organic acoustic elements with gritty electric guitar power chords. The vocals should be raw, gravelly, and powerful—reminiscent of a mountain folk singer. Incorporate a soaring Bansuri (bamboo flute) that mirrors the guitar melody. The production should feel 'live' and stadium-ready, balancing traditional Himalayan soul with the energy of 90s blues-rock.
params.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Deep, resonant Madal solo: Dhin-ta-nan-na, Dhin-ta-nan-na)
(Distorted electric guitar fades in with a long, sustained chord)

[Verse 1]
Nidhaar ko pasina, bagera gayo
Kholi ko bagar ma, baluwa bhayo
Junuko ujyalo, heri-heri thaki sakyo
Yo mann ko bhari ta, jahile tyahi rahyo.

[Chorus]
(Drums and Bass enter heavy)
Hey... katai janchu bhanthe, tyahi purano bato
Sirma chha rittai, tara mann bhari mato
Sathi-bhai chhuttie, kuro tyo niraalo
Ujyalo khojda khojdai, bhayo jhan adhyaro!

[Bridge]
(High-energy guitar solo with folk-inflected scales)
Aashai-aash ma, baisai gayo...
Bholi bhanda bhandai, hami lai k bhayo?

[Outro]
(Madal rhythm intensifies, then slows down)
Ho... ho... ho...
(Fading flute melody)
